Text: The product shall display all product images at a minimum resolution of 1920x1440 pixels for desktop viewports and 720x540 pixels for mobile viewports, with automatic format conversion to WebP with JPEG fallback to reduce load times below 2 seconds on 4G networks while maintaining visual fidelity across high-DPI displays up to 3x pixel density.
Label: Look and Feel

Text: The system shall employ a color-coded visual differentiation scheme for vehicle status indicators, using distinct hues such as green for active vehicles, yellow for maintenance alerts, red for critical failures, and blue for idle units, enabling dispatch coordinators to quickly assess fleet health at a glance without reading textual labels.
Label: Look and Feel

Text: The medication reconciliation module shall implement a card-based spatial layout with clear visual separation between active prescriptions, discontinued medications, and potential drug interactions, arranged in columns that adapt to both landscape tablet orientation and portrait desktop monitor configurations.
Label: Look and Feel

Text: The platform must display product information through a clear visual hierarchy where critical details such as pricing, availability status, and calls-to-action are positioned prominently, allowing customers to quickly assess key attributes without cognitive overload.
Label: Look and Feel

Text: The system shall organize vehicle status information using a hierarchical visual structure where critical alerts appear at the top-level view, followed by operational metrics, then detailed diagnostic data, enabling developers to quickly locate relevant display components.
Label: Look and Feel

Text: The vehicle status gauge component shall display an arc-shaped progress indicator spanning 270 degrees, with a gauge radius of 60 pixels, numeric readout in 18-point Helvetica Bold positioned at the gauge center, and colored segments transitioning from #00AA00 (0-33% utilization) through #FFA500 (34-66% utilization) to #CC0000 (67-100% utilization), with each segment boundary marked by a thin white tick line measuring 3 pixels in length.
Label: Look and Feel

Text: Status indicator icons representing vehicle operational states (idle, in-transit, maintenance, offline) shall employ a color palette of green (#27AE60), blue (#3498DB), orange (#F39C12), and red (#E74C3C) respectively, with a minimum stroke width of 2 pixels and rounded corners at 4-pixel radius to maintain visual consistency across touchscreen displays with varying pixel densities.
Label: Look and Feel

Text: The information architecture shall organize fleet data through a hierarchical navigation structure that enables developers to implement intuitive pathways for accessing vehicle status, maintenance records, and operational metrics without requiring users to navigate through more than three menu levels.
Label: Look and Feel

Text: The interface shall employ a cohesive visual design language that reflects the organization's corporate branding guidelines while maintaining distinct visual zones for different functional areas such as vehicle monitoring, maintenance scheduling, and driver management.
Label: Look and Feel

Text: The healthcare information system's primary dashboard shall display patient vital signs using a soft gradient background that transitions from a calming light blue (#E8F4F8) at the top to white at the bottom, with rounded corner cards containing real-time metrics in a sans-serif font (Segoe UI, 14pt) to reduce eye strain during extended clinical shifts in hospital environments with standard LED lighting.
Label: Look and Feel

Text: Footer section typography shall utilize a sans-serif font family (Segoe UI, Roboto, or equivalent) at 13-pixel font size with 1.5 line-height spacing, rendered in color #6B7280 to establish visual hierarchy separation from main content while maintaining readability for developers implementing semantic HTML structures.
Label: Look and Feel

Text: The Fleet Management System shall present a cohesive visual identity that aligns with the organization's corporate branding guidelines, incorporating the company logo, brand colors, and typography standards consistently across all user interfaces to reinforce brand recognition among field operators, office managers, and executives accessing the platform.
Label: Look and Feel

Text: All interactive elements including buttons, links, and form fields shall utilize rounded corners with a 4-pixel border radius and adopt a soft blue color palette (#0066CC for primary actions, #004499 for hover states) to create a friendly, approachable interface that alleviates patient anxiety during medical record interactions.
Label: Look and Feel
